Hi Oliver,

Thanks for your interest — excited to demo Redwood Inference for the BlueBay team. Before I send a calendar invite, a quick timezone check so we avoid ambiguity across teams in US / EU / APAC and DST: I’ve listed three candidate slots below with explicit conversions. Please reply with the single slot that works (and tell us if you want a different time).

Option A — Morning PT / Late US East:
- Thurs Aug 14, 9:00 AM PT (12:00 PM ET / 16:00 UTC / 18:00 CET / 21:30 IST)

Option B — EU-friendly:
- Thurs Aug 14, 5:00 PM CET (4:00 PM BST / 16:00 UTC / 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET / 20:30 IST)

Option C — APAC-friendly:
- Fri Aug 15, 10:30 AM IST (5:00 AM UTC / 10:30 AM IST / 1:30 AM PT / 4:30 AM ET / 11:30 AM CET) 

Notes:
- IST = India Standard Time (UTC+5:30).
- CET listed above assumes Central European Summer Time where applicable; I included UTC values to avoid DST confusion.
- If you prefer, we can put the invite time in UTC in the subject line so calendar clients show the conversion explicitly.

Once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite (ICS) and a short mutual action plan (MAP) PDF. Rishi will run the demo; Marissa will join for the technical Q&A.

Best,

- Our team in Mumbai (India) is on IST (UTC+5:30) — please use the 24-hour conversions you put in.
- Option A is a bit late for our business leads here (21:30 IST). Option B at 20:30 IST would work for 2–3 people, and Option C (Fri Aug 15, 10:30 AM IST) would be ideal for the APAC folks.
- Note: we have a short regional holiday on Thurs Aug 14 afternoon that might reduce attendance.

Can you do Option C on Fri Aug 15 at 10:30 AM IST? If you send the invite with a UTC time in the subject (e.g., "2025-08-15 05:00 UTC — Redwood demo w/ BlueBay"), it helps our people add it correctly to mixed timezone calendars.
